In this paper, a modified equilateral triangular microstrip antenna (MT-MSA) with folded slots is proposed to achieve multi-frequency operation. The proposed antenna is fed by an L-probe and has folded slots having constant intervals. Experiment results showed that satisfactory performance was achieved in both return-loss and radiation pattern characteristics

articleTitle: Inverse link capacity based on an interference product model in CDMA cellular networks
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper established a product model composed of such two correlated random variables as relative distance and relative shadowing under the assumption that the subscriber is always connected to the base stations with minimum path loss. Both factors, by means of which a closed-form expression of the reverse link capacity can be utilized to estimate the largest number of users a cell supports, determine the interference a ser in surrounding cells adds to the target cell.

articleTitle: Study on the wander for Gaussian-beam propagation through the atmospheric turbulence
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Based on the Markov approximation, the wave structure function of Gaussian-beam and the theory of higher order-th statistics moment is applied to the problem of the wander effects for Gaussian-beam propagation in the atmospheric turbulence. The formula of the wander for Gaussian-beam propagation without/with considering the outer-scale effect is obtained, the numerical result of the wander is present and discussed for Gaussian-beam propagation along the horizontal path.

articleTitle: BJMOSFET based on SOI
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A new-style compound device of BJT and MOS-bipolar junction MOSFET based on SOI (SOI BJMOSFET) has been proposed. The structure of SOI BJMOSFET was introduced and the work principle was analyzed reasonably. Its different characteristics were also discussed in detailed. From the detailed analysis and research, it is concluded that SOI BJMOSFET is assuredly a much more excellent new-style solid electronic device.

articleTitle: Low-density parity-check codes based on sparse binary sequences
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel and simple construction of regular LDPC codes using sparse binary sequences. The distribution matrix of ones in a parity-check matrix is introduced into this new construction. The cyclic cross correlation function and the cyclic auto correlation function are employed to ensure that the girth of Tanner graph is at least eight. The new codes perform well using the sum-product algorithm for iterative decoding. Low encoding complexity can also be achieved due to the inherent quasi-cyclic structure of the LDPC codes.

articleTitle: Optimum design of S-G-S and S-O-S interconnects using least mean square method
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Two new interconnects structure called S-G-S (signal-ground-signal) and S-O-S (signal-opened-signal) interconnects are proposed and a method is presented to optimum design of them. A frequency domain approach to efficiently minimize the far-end crosstalk in S-G-S and S-O-S interconnects is proposed. The approach is based on a least mean square method. The approach is being evaluated using an example.

articleTitle: Multi-polarization planar array for satellite TV reception
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper microstrip planar array of 16 elements is designed and simulated. It operates in the C band, from 3.7 to 4.2 GHz. It gives gain of 19.5 dB. It can produce many types of polarizations such as E/spl theta/, E/spl Omega/, right and left circular. In all these ear polarizations the co-polar level is around 15 dB higher than cross polar level. The microstrip planar array for C band satellite TV reception can be easily constructed just by increasing the number of patches from 16 to 256. The array is simulated using ADS 2003A software.

articleTitle: HPM absorption caused by self-action phenomenon in the lower ionosphere
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: HPM may cause many non-linear effects when it propagates in the ionosphere. HPM self-action phenomenon is one of the nonlinear effects which could influence HPM propagation notably. This paper analyses self-action working mechanism and calculates HPM power density in the ionosphere quantitatively. The results have great referable value to HPM propagation research in the ionosphere.

articleTitle: Joint multiuser detection and beamforming with power control in synchronous CDMA system
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Power control, beamforming and multiuser detection (MUD) can suppress interference in CDMA systems. In this paper by exploiting characteristic of beamforming and MUD, we propose a new decorrelating multiuser detection algorithm from beamforming gain and correlating matrix. For computation complexity, we further propose an algorithm of decorrelating MUD on clustered users. While beamforming can cancel out most of the interference from users out of cluster, MUD for clustered users can suppress the remaining interference. This algorithm can cancel out most of the MAI and at the same time need much less computation. Simulation results show the improvement brought by this algorithm

articleTitle: Design of compact 2.45 GHz microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Based on shorting pin technique and common PCB (printed circuit board) technology, a 10 mm-diameter microstrip antenna is designed and manufactured to meet critical miniaturization requirement for special applications. The antenna is fabricated on microwave substrate (tan/spl delta/ = 0.001, /spl epsi//sub r/=3.5,h = 4 mm). It resonates at 2.45 GHz (ISM band); while the impedance bandwidth reaches 104 MHz and the gain approach 0 dBi. Both theoretic analysis and practical measurement prove that employing moderate thick and low loss substrate helps to enhance the impedance bandwidth and efficiency of the microstrip antenna for size reduction.

articleTitle: A novel LAS-MIMO CDMA system with SISO multiuser detection
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The large area synchronized (LAS) smart spreading codes having an interference free window (IFW), makes high-dimension modulation patterns be feasible in CDMA system. Combining MIMO with LAS codes can effectively take advantage of multipath delay spread and the random fading characteristic of the mobile propagation channel. In this paper, we show that by using the turbo product codes (TPC) to utilize soft-in-soft-out (SISO) iterative multi-user detection algorithm in such a system, significant performance improvement, and high spectrum efficiency could be achieved.

articleTitle: Measurement and analysis of electromagnetic field around transformer substation and base station using wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: When transformer substation is under base station, electromagnetic fields around transformer substation is complex and especially base station perhaps is so great influenced from transformer substation that communication is interrupted. This paper mainly uses a wavelet denoising method for partial discharge (PD) signal and base station signal extraction from the electromagnetic interference existing in electrical machines such as high frequency sinusoidal noise, pulse-shaped noise .The proposed denoising method is performed through multi-resolution signal decomposition, numerical simulating base station signal and PD pulse immersed in severe noise have been investigated. In conclusion, base station signal and PD pulse can distinguished from a noisy background, thus providing the reference for EMI measurement and design.

articleTitle: An efficient multiple access scheme for dynamic subband allocation in OFDMA system
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Dynamic subcarrier allocation is a promising technique to improve signal quality and system capacity of OFDMA system, especially in frequency selective radio channels. We focus on dynamic subband allocation in OFDMA system because of the low signaling overhead, low complexity of multi-user receiver, and good multiple access interference (MAI) performance. In this paper, we propose an efficient centralized control scheme in multiple access protocol to resolve collision of subband application among multiple asynchronous users. Subband handover is employed in the multiple access protocol to track changes of frequency selectivity of radio channel. Simulation results show that the scheme effectively improves the performance of average bit error rate (BER) of multiple users and system capacity. The improved dynamic subband allocation scheme improves the system performance and ensures reliable communications over asynchronous frequency-selective multiple user channel.

articleTitle: New concept of a high-speed low-power digital interface for multi-standard mobile transceiver RFIC's in 0.13 /spl mu/m CMOS
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper a new concept of a high-speed low power digital interface between the RF and the base-band chip of a multi-standard mobile phone is presented and compared to other popular interfaces. First, the requirements on a digital interface at the digital output of a multi-standard mobile phone RF front-end are explained. The paper gives an insight of popular digital interfaces and presents a new concept which is more robust against the ground bounce effect. We also show measurement results of a realized test chip that show functionality and benefits of the new concept.

articleTitle: Inverse scattering of buried complex object by TE wave illumination
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The inverse scattering of buried complex object by transverse electric (TE) wave illumination is investigated. Dielectric cylinders coated on a conductor of unknown permittivities are buried in one half space and scatter a group of unrelated TE waves incident from another half space where the scattered field is recorded. By proper arrangement of the various unrelated incident fields, the difficulties of ill-posedness and nonlinearity are circumvented, and the permittivity distribution can be reconstructed through simple matrix operations. The algorithm is based on the moment method and the unrelated illumination method. Good reconstruction is obtained even in the presence of additive Gaussian random noise in measured data. In addition, the effect of noise on the reconstruction result is also investigated.

articleTitle: Location error analysis of direction finding location system
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: With large detection range, working normally in the condition of electronic countermeasures, direction-finding location systems have attracted great interest of researchers. And a lot of people pay much more attention to passive location technique. But the emphasis of many researchers' work is passive location method, and the location error analysis of multiple passive sensors has received little attention until now. This paper studies the problem, and the minimum ambiguous location area is given. The relationship between the ambiguous location area and the bearing measurements of passive sensors (or the cut angle) is shown in simulation figures, and the positioning error distribution figure is also given. Some conclusions are drawn, which can be used for reference in collocating passive sensors to improve location precision.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis on the high frequency characteristics of MILO
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Through numerical calculation, the high frequency characteristics of magnetically insulated line oscillator (MILO) coaxial slow wave structure (SWS), the frequencies of the eigen modes and their distributions of coaxial SWS are presented. The sizes of MILO are: the inner radius of the primary SWS and the RF choke 4.6 cm and 4.2 cm, the cathode radius 3 cm. When the frequency in MILO is from 3.6 to 4.4 GHz, the RF chock cavity stops leakage of microwaves toward the pulse power, unexpectedly increases the output power. The cutoff frequency of the primary SWS is from 4.5 to 4.9 GHz. A wave whose frequency is near cutoff is evanescent in the primary SWS. In addition, we calculate the eigen frequencies of MILO with open boundary. The frequencies of 3/spl pi//8, /spl pi//2, 5/spl pi//8, 3/spl pi//4 mode achieved in the computer simulation are 3.18, 3.76, 3.93, 4.11 GHz and the corresponding frequencies in "cold" measurement are 3.80, 3.94, 4.08, 4.18 GHz. The experimental results are in accordance with the results of the numerical solution.

articleTitle: Design of delay mapping receiver for GPS remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Backgrounds and advantages of sea surface wind remote sensing technique based on GPS and the ocean scattered signal measure technique are introduced. Five main techniques are discussed as improving the signal noise ratio, dual front-end receiver design, calculating the specular point code delay, working modes configuration and the embedded firmware function. Inshore flight tests were done in Tianjin with the receiver mounted on an airplane. Results show that the delay mapping receiver (DMR) can receive direct and ocean scattered GPS signal simultaneously which achieves the performance specifications.

articleTitle: Analysis of instability of compressed signals parameters in radar systems
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The main tactic-technical characteristics of the radar are defined to a considerable extent by parameters of sounding signal and by their processing system. Realization of potential tactic-technical characteristics of the radar with chosen signal parameters and processing system depends in the first place on stability of signals. In this case, it is expediently to take into account the following signals instability sources: former of sounding signals, sounding signals power amplifier, amplifying-converting section of receiving device, optimal filter (filter of compression) of a complex signal.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and recovery scheme based on high-speed serial interface applied in 3G radio base stations
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: High-speed serial interface is used in 3G radio base stations to provide deployment flexibility for the mobile network operators. Performance and reliability are always the most crucial issues in nowadays communication systems and concurrent fault detection and diagnosis and recovery are necessary. This paper examines the problem of diagnosing and recovering from processing node failures in 3G radio base station. The advantages and difficulties of high-speed serial interface are introduced and the designs are relied on these features.

articleTitle: A high sensitive active integrated microstrip probe-fed antenna for 2.4 GHz receivers
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, a novel high sensitive active integrated antenna (AIA) structure for 2.4 GHz receivers is developed. The antenna is made of a rectangle microstrip probe-fed antenna and a front-end low noise amplifier (LNA) without a matching circuit in between. They are integrated in a two-layer planar structure and operate at 2.48 GHz. The final measurement shows: comparing to the passive antenna, an entire system including antenna and LNA provides a higher gain of 13.87 dB, while the radiation patterns are found to be almost the same as those of the passive antenna

articleTitle: QoS guaranteed vertical handoff signaling scheme for heterogeneous networks
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Signaling process of vertical handoff with QoS support between GPRS and WLAN is developed. Schemes of handoff preparing loop (HPL) and layer 3 (mobile IP layer) bi-direction connections between GPRS and WLAN are proposed in order to provide QoS guarantee. However, bi-direction connection will occupy more network resources. To solve this problem, a parameter "connecting lifetime" is introduced. The latency analysis and simulation results show that systems could achieve better performance in terms of handoff latency and outage probability.

articleTitle: Software radios applying in ad hoc network nodes' adaptive detection
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The ad hoc network terminal nodes may move randomly, and the radio propagation condition changes quickly, consequently the network topology will be changed quickly and arbitrarily by unpredictable way. This paper aims at programmable detection module in software radio application. From the simulation results of MPSK adaptive detection software, it can be concluded that adaptive software makes the system easy to realize detection function for various applications.

articleTitle: Measurement of noise figure of active microwave devices and the extraction of noise feature parameters
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A modified method for determining the four noise parameters of a microwave active device from single-source noise figure is proposed which eliminates the need for tuners and hence greatly reduces the complexity and cost of performing accurate noise figure measurement. The method also offers the extraction algorithm of four noise parameters based on the additional information of equivalent circuits of DUT and its two-port noise analysis models. Finally, an illustrative experiment is also made to demonstrate its validity.

articleTitle: Performance degradation of radio channels when mobile phone base stations are installed near residential area
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of microwave oven power output on the data channels of base stations installed near residential buildings. The experimental interference results, shows that the performance of base station data channels hi close proximity to microwave oven are significantly degraded.

articleTitle: Mesh termination conditions for the analysis of scattering by dielectric cylinders
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Recently, a novel method has been proposed by the present authors for the truncation of a finite difference (FD) or finite element (FE) mesh. It has been successfully applied to the analysis of two-dimensional scattering problems by perfectly conducting cylinders and is extended here to scattering problems by dielectric cylinders. Based on the equivalence principle, the scattered field outside of the object surface can be generated by an equivalent electric current and an equivalent magnetic current. Through discretization procedures, discretized boundary conditions for mesh truncation can be derived. Combined with the FD/FE method, two-dimensional scattering problems by dielectric cylinders can be solved rigorously and efficiently. Numerical results presented show the validity of the extended method.

articleTitle: New space-time channel models for 2 GHz mobile communications systems with an antenna array
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Two new space-time channel models are introduced for simulating 2 GHz wireless mobile communication systems in outdoor environments. The models combine in reason the power and delay parameters in different environments provided by ITU or 3GPP and the angle parameters generated according to 3GPP/3GPP2 joint spatial channel modeling adhoc. The new models can be directly used in the simulations of TD-SCDMA systems and can be easily extended for application to wireless systems in other frequency bands.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Azimuth and elevation estimation for multipath signals exploiting cyclostationarity and temporal smoothing technology
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The two-dimensional (2-D) multipath direction of arrival (DOA) estimation algorithm using a planar array is provided exploiting higher order cyclostationarity (HOCS) and temporal smoothing technology. Based on real mobile communication channel characteristics, in which the multipath reflection coefficient changes more rapidly than their DOAs, the temporal smoothing is applied to resolve 2-D DOAs of coherent signals. Compared with all the previous multipath azimuth/elevation angle estimation methods, the proposed method achieves further array aperture extension, as well as its powerful capability of noise-suppression and signal-selectivity due to the use of HOCS.

articleTitle: Transmission performance evaluation of optical signals propagating in microwave photonic links
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A simulator of optical signals propagating in microwave photonic link over WDM system is proposed. By use of modified SSFM solving CNLS, it can simulate propagation of optical signals modulated by microwave. The simulation results show the impairments induced by PMD, nonlinear effects and crosstalk in microwave photonic link.

articleTitle: Research of TCP Vegas congestion control algorithm over GEO satellite networks
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The TCP Vegas congestion control algorithm is studied in GEO satellite networks. Based on Vegas algorithm, a new improved Vegas3 algorithm is presented. During the congestion avoidance, the improvement measure is to divide network conditions into more particular state; then to take special countermeasure for special conditions. This algorithm integrates Vegas, Vegas-A, and Vegas1 algorithm into one algorithm, and adjusts the parameters alpha and beta of Vegas dynamically for adapting to the change of network conditions. The result of our simulation shows that the Vegas3 algorithm is superior to the Reno, SACK, Vegas, Vegas1, Vegas2 and Vegas-A algorithm in throughput and round trip time.

articleTitle: Research on an electromagnetic wave exposed system for animal experiments
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The effect on the electromagnetic radiation biology is one of topics in great demand, which scientists have been exploring. The significant on electromagnetic radiation biology effect to be explored is introduced at first, then an electromagnetic wave exposed system to be used in researching electromagnetic radiation biology effects is introduced. The configuration, performance and specification of the system are described.

articleTitle: Parallel interference cancellation with frequency diversity combining for multi-carrier DS-CDMA
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper proposes a parallel interference cancellation for multi-carrier DS-CDMA (which is termed FDC-PIC) by integrating frequency diversity combining. The simulations are made over FDC-PIC with respect to hard, soft and linear decisions, respectively, and we conclude that FDC-PIC acquires superior performance improvement over match-filtered (MF) receiver of multi-carrier DS-CDMA. With an increase in interference cancellation stages, the system performance improves further. The initial 2 stages bring the most dominant performance improvement, but up to the 3rd stage the system performance improves little. It is also shown by the simulation results that FDC-PIC with soft decision would exhibit the best performance with a high implementation complexity, while FDC-PIC with linear decision acquires performance comparable to that of FDC-PIC with soft decision with a reduced-complexity if the number of the interference cancellation stages is the same, which indicates that FDC-PIC with linear decision has optimal performance/complexity tradeoff and therefore promises for practical application in future.

articleTitle: OPNET optimization of ad-hoc sensor network configuration for navigation and positioning
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Instead of using GPS (global positioning system), people are researching to use ad-hoc network protocols and applications to obtain the navigation and positioning information. To fulfil these requirements, the ad-hoc network should have good performances such as high speed, more accurate and low power demanded, and its sensor network needs to be optimized. The optimization introduced in this paper is achieved by modeling and simulating using OPNET. The main tasks are to find the optimum power range and the optimum number of sensors in a specified area.

articleTitle: Actuality and development of research system in wireless information system
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The paper describes the advancement and development of the future wireless information system, and emphasize on research system, key problems, future development and some ideas in research. The research of wireless information system dependent on both the development of future network and the actuality. Now owing to existing multiple wireless access networks, for examples, UMTS, WLAN, WFA, ad-hoc and DVB-T etc., and difficult to realize the unity standardization in a short time; while large quantities heretours networks had been built according to the need of operators and enterprises

articleTitle: Analysis of transmit-receive characterization of UWB impulse signals
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In the paper, the time domain electric field integral equation (TD-EFIE) in conjunction with the reciprocity principle is applied to synthesize the transmitting impulse signals on condition that the receiving signals have already been known. In addition, the effects of light-of-sight (LOS) and non-light-of-sight (NLOS) propagation paths on the transmitting and receiving impulse signals are also discussed. Furthermore, a novel averaged scheme has been proposed in the paper to keep the balance between eliminating oscillation phenomena and keeping the accuracy of computational results. In the analysis, impulse waveform and the shape of the antenna are arbitrarily given. The bowtie antennas excited by Gaussian monocycle pulses and ultra-wide band (UWB) slot antennas excited by prolate spheroidal wave functions (PSWF)-type UWB pulses are taken as examples and the computed results are compared with the originally known receiving impulse signals. The good agreement between them shows the correctness and effectiveness of the method proposed. The method also possesses the merits of clarity in conception and simplicity in computation.

articleTitle: Coplanar transmission line exposed to electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The concept of this paper is to find the voltages and currents induced by external plane waves on a coplanar transmission line. This three dimensional problem is subdivided into two simple problems: "two dimensional forced terms problem" and "one dimensional transmission line problem". The method is evaluated with conventional three dimensional full wave analysis softwares like HFSS.

articleTitle: Research on ESD interference effect on interface circuit of microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, a typical single-chip circuit is designed to simulate serial communication interface in order to study the effect of ESD EMP. Using the ESD generator, the radiation effect experiments of ESD on the single chip microprocessor (SCM) system have been carried out. By analyzing the experiment data, some rules of the typical serial communication circuit under ESD are presented.

articleTitle: A new UTD formulation for multiple cylindrical diffraction
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper describes a new formulation of the uniform theory of diffraction (UTD) with application to multiple cylindrical structures. The new formulas present some modified UTD diffraction coefficients in cooperation with a slope diffraction term for higher accuracy in the electromagnetic modeling. The above are then combined with a simple ray tracing algorithm that takes into account multipath propagation between cylindrical structures. Comparisons with existing analytical models that employ other electromagnetic theories have shown that the new UTD solution can give very accurate results while it seems to be superior in terms of computation time and complexity. The solution can be applicable to radiowave paths which are characterized by convex structures and multipath propagation such as mountainous areas or urban areas with special rounded objects

articleTitle: Study of a novel algorithm on ADCP system
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Acoustic Doppler current profilers (ADCP) use acoustic energy directed along narrow beams for current measurement. The technique of measuring water velocity is widely studied in which the frequency estimation algorithm is a key factor. Conventional method has limitations in some instances, for an example, the quantity of sampling affects the precision of fast Fourier transform (FFT) algorithm which qualifies the system storage capacity highly. It can't be avoided under most circumstances. Furthermore, FFT algorithm doesn't work well while the quantity of data is small. A novel frequency estimator-enhanced least mean square (ELMS) algorithm for a single complex sinusoid in complex white Gauss noise is proposed in ADCP system. Experimental results indicate that it needs less data than conventional FFT algorithm. At the same time, the robust algorithm can estimate the spectrum value efficiently when the SNR is 0 dB.

articleTitle: Performance analyse of TH-PPM ultra-wideband system with EC signal
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The M-ary equi-correlated (EC) signal based on the principle of TH-PPM in ultra-wideband (UWB) system is adopted. In this paper, its construction method and correlation properties are discussed, the system performance are analyzed and simulated, the results show that EC signal can greatly simplify receiver and improve the probability of bit error for given conditions.

articleTitle: Three dimensional finite element BPM in time domain
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A 3D-FEM-TD-BPM equation obtained form Maxwell equations with SVEA and pade approximation. The question of cycloidal boundary could be solved efficiently when isoparametric triangular division is adopted. The division in time-domain (TD) and space-domain is used to solve the obtained equation.

articleTitle: Application of WLAN in JTAV
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A combined WLAN (wireless local area network) and RFID (radio frequency identification) system and its application in joint total asset visibility (JTAV) are studied. The working principle, choices of working frequencies and terminal roaming of this system as well as smart storage and in-transit visibility (ITV) of JTAV are discussed. The application of such JTAV in Qingxin County of Guangdong Province in China through remote linkages in WLAN is introduced which can also be applied in disaster relief, maneuver and training of reservists.

articleTitle: Decision aided channel estimation in clipped OFDM
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Clipping is a popular and simple method to overcome large peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) in orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems, but it results in a nonlinear distortion, which degrades the performance of channel estimation and signal detection. In this paper, clipping effect on channel estimation is analyzed, a decision-aided channel estimation method to mitigate the clipping distortion is developed and its potential gain in channel estimation is derived. The gain can be obtained by an iterative channel estimation and signal detection process. Theoretical and simulation results show that the decision aided method can effectively improve the performance of channel estimation in clipped OFDM.

articleTitle: A FAFFA-FIPWA algorithm for two-dimensional electromagnetic scattering problem
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Recently, rapid progress is made in fast algorithm of integral equation(IE) method to accelerate matrix-vector multiplication which occurs in iterative method, thus making it possible to solve large scalar problem through numerical techniques. In this paper, A fast far-field approximation (FAFFA) [C.C. Lu et al, 1995] technique is combined into the fast inhomogeneous plane wave algorithm (FIPWA) [Bin Hu et al, 1999], namely FAFFA-FIPWA, to further speed up matrix-vector multiplication in the process of iteration. The interaction is divided into three regions: near region, resonant region and far region. In near region, the coupling is computed directly, and in resonant region, the FIPWA is needed. When in far region, the pure FIPWA is not necessary again since only one direction k/sub 0/ makes main contribution in translation from source point to field point in this case, so the FAFFA is used in this region.

articleTitle: Technique allows simple design of microwave DROs
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A new type of highly stabilized GaAs FET oscillator using a dielectric resonator and a stabilized resistor in the feedback circuit has been developed. The oscillator fabricated with a microwave integrated circuit has a high external quality factor. Dielectric-resonator oscillators (DROs) offer such advantages as good frequency stability, the possibility of tuning with varactors, and simple, low-cost construction. A DOR design method is available that combines accuracy and simplicity as it requires only small-signal parameters (which are typically available from manufacturers). The microwave characteristics of the GaAs FET oscillator have revealed: 1) High efficiency of 20 percent output power at 10 GHz, 2) a wide tuning range more than 1000 MHz, 3) a wide oscillation frequency from 9 to 14 GHz with same MIC pattern by using five dielectric resonators of different sizes, 4) a high-frequency stability as low as 150 kHz in the temperature range from -20 to +60 /spl deg/C.

articleTitle: A class of turbo-like LDPC codes and their decoding based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Turbo codes and LDPC codes are both superior to other error correcting codes. These two families of codes have some similarities. It seems a good idea to design new codes combining these two codes. Through the analysis of turbo codes, we can consider turbo codes as block codes and find their matrix H. In this paper, we give a new class of turbo-like LDPC codes combining the advantages of turbo and LDPC codes and a decoding method based on neural network. A lot of simulations have been made and the results reveal that these codes have robuster performance than turbo codes.

articleTitle: A novel precision measuring algorithms of frequency characteristic based on curve fitting
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents a novel measuring algorithms of frequency characteristic by using curve fitting techniques. In comparison with other method, the proposed algorithms can effectively improve the measuring precision in the presence of Gauss noise and harmonic disturbance. Simulation results have shown the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: The design of optimum blind audio watermark decoder using higher order spectrum
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Digital watermarking is an effective means to resolve copyright protection problem by embedding additional information into digital media. The errors of watermark detector can undermine the credibility of a watermarking system. It is crucial to minimize the false detection rate in watermark detection. Many proposed watermark detector were based on correlation detection. In these cases, the performance of the detector depends mainly on signal to noise ration. With decreasing of SNR, the detection performance will deteriorate. A new optimum blind audio watermark detector is proposed based on higher order spectrum of the audio based on discrete wavelet transform domain in this paper, as higher order statistics are insensitive to Gaussian noise no matter it is white or colored. Bispectrum of audio is used during detection with constant false alarm rate, which is very useful in signal detection. The advantage of detector based on bispectrum is proved in theory and the experimental results show that the detector based on bispectrum is more robust than the detector based on correlation.

articleTitle: Study of PCB test in electromagnetic shielded test fixture
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A novel test methodology for PCB test that provides several different levels of testing from a single test is presented in the paper. This paper provides helpful information to use both before and during the creation of test hardware and software. It includes test philosophies, instrumentation requirements, testing level, testing components and configuration for PCB test. This paper also contains measured values and recommendations that should be followed in an effort to get the PCB test environment operational. Finally, this paper provides the PCB test flow diagram and descriptions.

articleTitle: The application of the minimum energy consumption principle to the medium parameters constraint
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The minimum energy consumption principle (MECP) is a general rule holding true for all systems such as life system, non-life system and linear balance or unbalance mechanics system, which is widely applied in the material mechanical science, biological science, even in society science. This paper is aimed to introduce this principle into the field of electromagnetics, and obtain a constraint condition for arbitrary non-dispersive loss medium parameters using MECP, which provide a new way to investigate the constraint relationship of complex electromagnetic medium.

articleTitle: Transient analysis of the current along the cable shield under the external electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Under the excitation of the external electromagnetic wave, the current and voltage can be generated along the cable. A simple treatment with the ground wire is proposed. Based on the transmission line method, the current on cable shield was computed with different loads. The results of NEC testify the validity of the method. Finally some examples of transient current when EMP is illuminated upon the cable are analyzed, and some useful results are obtained in order to research die field-to-line coupling problem.

articleTitle: Feed gap influence for printed multiple ring fractal antennas
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A simple structure of printed multiple ring fractal antennas has already been investigated in our previous work, which demonstrate better performance than conventional antennas as dual-band or triple-band element This paper presents the feed gap influence for printed multiple ring fractal antennas. As the ground plane is under part of the feed line, the feed gap between antenna and ground plane is the key point for impedance matching and obtaining good performance of radiation pattern and S-parameter. After comparing a large number of simulation results, an expression is given to indicate the relationship between feed gap h and the radius of biggest ring R. The single antenna unit has the potential of operating in several of the currently existing systems such as GSM, UMTS, WLAN and Bluetooth.

articleTitle: Blind adaptive multiuser detection based on a constrained CM criterion in CDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Constant modulus (CM) is an important criterion in multiuser detection. Since the CM cost functions are non-convex and local minima exist. It is necessary to confine the searching space. In the paper we study the constraints for CM-based multiuser detection. A new constraint based on the MMSE criterion is proposed. Simulation results show the proposed algorithm is superior to some existing linearly constrained CM based algorithms.

articleTitle: Construction environment of personal handy phone system and it's management
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Personal handy phone system is a popular telecommunication system to citizens. However, with the awakening of citizens' environmental sense, the electromagnetic radiation problem caused by the base station of personal handy phone system (including antenna) is gradually attracting citizens' attention, and the visit and appeal about the environmental influence of personal handy phone system are increasing day by day Thus, it becomes a problem to deal with that whether the charge department of environment conservation administration brings the construction projects of personal handy phone system into environmental management or not and how to put environment management in force. This paper tries to demonstrate the problem in two aspects: practical need and law criterion.

articleTitle: Design of an input coupler for a Ka-band second harmonic gyroklystron amplifier
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A design of a coaxial input coupler with an outer TE/sub 811/ mode and inner TE/sub 021/ mode for the Ka-band second harmonic gyroklystron is presented in this paper. Simulation results from three-dimensional electromagnetic code show that 91% of the total energy is stored in the inner cylindrical cavity, and a circular TE/sub 021/ mode with high mode purity in an input cavity is obtained.

articleTitle: A virtual instrument detecting system for electromagnetic environment based on GPIB
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: At first the tendency towards of virtual instruments is introduced in this paper, the network of virtual instruments is the great important breakthrough in the history of instrument development. The text emphasize in the characteristic of hardware and software of the detecting system of electromagnetic environment virtual instruments based on the GPIB.

articleTitle: Wide capture range PLL with LC-VCO
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A wide capture range PLL with low phase noise is proposed and analyzed. The PLL incorporates a LC voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) to get low phase noise while the divider is controlled by low pass filter (LPF) voltage to achieve wide capture range. The proposed PLL is designed based on the SMIC 0.18-/spl mu/m 1P5M CMOS process with a 2.5 V supply voltage. HSPICE simulation shows that the output frequency of proposed PLL alternates from 0.3 GHz to 1.4 GHz, and the phase noise is below-120 dB at a 300 KHz offset from VCO center frequency.

articleTitle: A closed form analytical formulation for the coupling of an external electromagnetic wave with a microstrip line
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Utilizing the reciprocal theorem and transformed transmission line model, a closed form analytical solution in a very simple expression for the receive performance of a planar microstrip line in the frequency domain is presented, which indicate how the receiving performance of the microstrip line depends on the parameters of the microstrip line and the incident electromagnetic wave. Using the HFSS software by Ansoft, the coupling of an incident electromagnetic wave to a planar microstrip line is simulated. The simulation results are compared with the analytical results obtained in this paper, which shows fairly good agreement.

articleTitle: Adaptive interference cancellation synthesized SMI and eigenspace-based method for HF surface wave radar
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: High frequency (HF) interference typically exhibits a time-varying or non-stationary spatial structure for the propagation through ionosphere. Adaptive interference cancellation methods are known to degrade in this case. In this paper, a new approach that effectively suppresses the non-stationary interference without degrading target visibility is presented for high frequency surface wave radar (HFSWR) circumstance. The proposed method synthesizes the sample matrix inverse (SM) and eigenspace-based beamformer, which maintains the beam pattern to keep the target response as well as cancels the interference mostly. A computationally efficient algorithm based on Lagrange multiplier methodology is proposed to compute the beamformer weights. Its excellent performance was confirmed by the experiment data of a real system.

articleTitle: Use adaptive filter to demodulate MPAM signals
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The paper presents a novel method for demodulating the M-ary PAM (MPAM) signals basing on the adaptive transversal filter weigh. The commonly used least mean square (LMS) error adaptive filtering algorithm is employed for studying the demodulating procedure and the performance of the novel adaptive MPAM demodulation. The novel adaptive MPAM demodulation does not require the adaptive filter completing convergence. Therefore, the sampling rate and processing speed are decelerated. Computer simulation shows that the error rates in simulation agree well with that in theory. Also, it is indicated that the demodulation method has many advantages over conventional ones, such as being convenient in implementation with DSP technology and having lower error rates than correlation modulation at the same sampling rate.

articleTitle: The measurement uncertainty of electromagnetic conducted immunity test using CDN
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: We estimated the measurement uncertainty of electromagnetic conducted immunity using CDN (coupling/decoupling network). We analyzed the contribution factors for the uncertainty and obtained the uncertainty by each factor. The contributions of the uncertainty are the repeatability of measurement system; harmonics of power amplifier; the accuracy of power meter; mismatch between power amplifier and CDN; and mismatch between power meter and QDN. We obtained that the expanded uncertainty is 1.17 dB in level of confidence and /spl plusmn/ 0.43 V of error range in 3 V. These results could tell that the most important uncertainty contribution is mismatched between measurement system in electromagnetic conducted immunity test. Therefore, we know that it is important to match impedance on electromagnetic conducted immunity test.

articleTitle: Resistivity imaging using domain decomposition method
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The domain decomposition method is applied to solve the resistivity imaging problems in inhomogeneous media. The iterative solution is presented. Two examples are given to demonstrate the capability of this method, and the convergence rate is considered. The results show that this method is optimal for the resistivity imaging problems.

articleTitle: Sensitivity analysis of parabolic lossless nonuniform transmission lines based on port voltages and currents
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents a new method of frequency-domain sensitivity analysis for parabolic lossless nonuniform transmission line. The frequency-domain sensitivity formulas are expressed by the line port voltages and currents. Therefore this method can avoid the possible numerical instability caused by negative capacitance in Kuroda's identity in Liang Guishu et al. (2004). Examples and comparisons with sensitivity determined by perturbation are presented

articleTitle: Practical criterion in the stability analysis of linear control system with time-delay
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Criterions for stability of a linear control system with time-delay are widely applied in various fields such as microwave electronics, mobile satellites communication. Although conventional criterions by characteristic equations Is perfect from a theoretic point of view, it Is not very practical for real calculation, since the characteristic equation of a linear control system with time-delay is a transcendental equation. This paper present a practical criterion for stability analysis. By introducing some one-to-one transformations the transcendental characteristic equation concerned is converted to a polynomial. Based on this, a criterion which can be easily used by engineers is obtained.

articleTitle: Full-wave analysis of a wire antenna with a dielectric radome
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A circular cylindrical dipole and a Yagi-Uda antenna with an elliptical sphere radome of rotation have been exactly analyzed by using the method of moments (MoM). The good agreement of the numerical results with those from related references has shown the correctness of this MoM modeling. The numerical results show that the antenna radome will influence the antenna characteristics significantly, especially when the radome is not located in far-field region of the antenna.

articleTitle: Hybrid iterative strategy for parallel intersymbol interference channels
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid iterative strategy for exploiting transmit diversity using parallel independent intersymbol interference (ISI) channels. In this adaptive iterative strategy we use extrinsic information transfer (EXIT) chart tool to choose appropriate iterative method from iterative combining (IC) used as parallel concatenation turbo-like scheme and turbo equalization (TE) used as serial concatenation turbo-like scheme. It is show that the proposed hybrid iterative strategy provides excellent performance both analytically and through simulations without any compute complexity increase.

articleTitle: Fast decoding algorithm for low-density parity-check codes
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A fast decoding algorithm for low-density parity-check codes is presented based on graph decomposition and two-way message passing schedule. Simulations show that the convergence speed of the proposed algorithm is about twice as fast as that of the conventional belief propagation algorithm.

articleTitle: A new adaptive equalization technology in time-varying multipath channel
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In wireless communication system, with the increase of the maximum Doppler frequency shift, constant module algorithm (CMA), least mean squares (LMS) and recursive least squares (RLS) algorithms could not track the varying channel, which decrease the effect of equalization Kalman filter is the optimal one in tracking time-varying channel, but it needs training sequences, which restricts its application. This paper combines the three kinds of adaptive equalization algorithms and Kalman filter algorithm respectively for better effect and simulations show that our methods are effective.

articleTitle: An adaptive antenna using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This article simplifies the complexity of an adaptive antenna by employing the genetic algorithm. The system requires only the error signal and the phase-shifters in the discrete value to form an antenna pattern. An adaptive antenna with two elements and sixteen discrete steps of phase shifter is used. The instantaneous sample of an error signal is used as the cost function, which is minimized by using the genetic algorithm. Numerical results show that this antenna can improve signal to noise ratio in excess of 15 dB.

articleTitle: Using the wavelet analysis based noise canceling technique to detect the integrity of the compensating capacitors of UM71 track circuit
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The integrity of the compensating capacitors of UM71 track circuit has a direct influence on the reliable operating of the track circuit and the cab signaling device. For this purpose, a wavelet analysis based method is proposed in this paper to detect the integrity of the compensating capacitors of UM71 track circuit, by making use of the recorded data in the cab signal recorder. The results of laboratory simulation and the calculation based on actual data from railway site shows that this method is simple for use, fast for integrity detection, highly accurate, thus being suitable for the practical application on railway site

articleTitle: Simulation study on polarimetric microwave emission of ocean surface: model comparison and analysis
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: There are a few polarimetric emissivity models derived from solving ocean surface electromagnetic boundary value problem theoretically. In this paper, the full Stokes parameters of ocean surface emission simulated by three emissivity models at various ocean state were reviewed and inter-comparisons of the results from numerical simulation are carried out in detail, the effects of wave spectrums on the ocean surface emissivities were evaluated. The simulated four Stokes parameters of emission were compared with those by experimental formulations derived from airborne or spaceborne microwave radiometers.

articleTitle: Sleeping mode design in non-centre terminal
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper we propose a method to reduce energy consumption in non-centre terminal. All the circuits but CPU in non-centre terminal can be switched off into a sleeping mode when the terminal is in standby state. We study the selection of sleeping time and working time in a mathematics way on the premise of not reducing the signaling transmission performance, i.e., more lost frames, longer frame waiting times. At last we discuss the performance of the terminal

articleTitle: High power pulses interaction in the low ionosphere
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications

At the end of this paper, some conclusions are given after qualitative analysis

articleTitle: Impact of PMD on the Performance of NOLM and Compensation by HN-FBG in Microwave Photonic Systems
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The impact of the first-order and second-order PMD on the performance of NOLM is studied by the split-step Fourier method (SSFM) based on the coupled nonlinear Schrödinger equation (CNLSE), including sinusoidal modulation signals and power transmission function of NOLM with the first- and second-order PMD. Furthermore, the compensation method of PMD by the high-birefringence method of PMD by the high-birefringence nonlinearly-chirped fiber Bragg grating (HN-FBCG) in the middle of the fiber loop of NOLM is put forward.

articleTitle: Filter bank based multiuser receiver for wireless OFDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: One challenge associated with OFDMA is how to effectively separate signals of different users in mobile system. Another one is that MAI (multiple access interference) limits the performance of OFDMA system. In this paper, a novel filter bank based OFDMA system design is proposed to solve the above problems in subband allocation OFDMA system. In the scheme, OFDM modulation is employed in data-carrying subband for each user. The polyphase filter bank (PPFB) effectively decreases MAI and separates the overlapped multiuser's signal, which simplifies the multiuser receiver into a cluster of single-user receivers in a synchronous or asynchronous channel. The proposed scheme retains all the advantages of OFDM modulation and PPFB multiplexing. The signal processing model in frequency domain is given. Demodulation performance is investigated. Investigations show that the proposed multiuser receiver effectively separates distinct users and depresses MAI compared to subband OFDMA system; it is elegant, flexible, and robust to multipath delay spread of radio channel compare to filtered multitone transmission (FMT) system.

articleTitle: Bitron - a new high power microwave device
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Bitron, as a new type of high power microwave device, is proposed in the paper. The parameters (such as microwave power and its efficiency) based on the theoretical analysis has been realized on 2.5D PEC (particle in cell) simulation code. This device composes of two parts: one modulation cavity and one output cavity. The couple exists between these two cavities, so the oscillation occurs under certain conditions. X band bitron is designed in the paper, and its theoretical efficiency is 29.4%. And the process is also realized by 2.5 PIC simulation code, and the efficiency is 28%, the microwave frequency 9.42 GHz, the power 2.25 GW.

articleTitle: A joint detection method for horizontal-BLAST architecture
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Layered space-time codes (BLAST) architecture can achieve high channel capacity by deploying multiple transmit and receive antennas. In practice the performance of BLAST is mainly limited by error propagation. To avoid performance degradation caused by this impact, this paper proposes a joint detection method for horizontal-BLAST system. Combining the BLAST detection with decoding algorithm, the proposed method mitigates error propagation across layers. Simulation results have shown that the new method improved the performance of H-BLAST system.

articleTitle: A novel multiple access protocol for highly dynamic self-organizing networks
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Based on the concept of contention reservation and polling transmission, a user-dependent perfect-scheduling multiple access (UPMA) protocol for supporting node mobility and multihop architecture in highly dynamic self-organizing networks is described. In the protocol, a distributed clustering network architecture acquired by self-organizing algorithm and a main idea of random reserving channel resources to get polling service are adopted, so that the hidden terminals (HT) and exposed terminals (ET) problems existed in traffic transmission due to multihop architecture and wireless transmission method can be eliminated completely. Finally, the performance comparison of UPMA protocol with carrier sense multiple access with collision avoidance (CSMA/CA) and polling protocols by OPNET simulation is presented. Simulation results show that UPMA protocol can overcome the disadvantages of CSMA/CA and polling protocols, and achieve higher throughput, lower average message delay and less average message dropping rate.

articleTitle: An automatic filtering algorithm in the domain WT coefficient's maxima
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents a method, which can automatically implement the Mallat's filtering algorithm in WT (wavelet transform) coefficient's maxima domain. It can automatically find the maxima which corresponding to the same edges through all the scales (which we called the same edge maxima (SE-maxima) in this paper), and can be applied in many field for signal's automatic detection and de-noising. Also, it makes it possible for real time implementation for edge detecting based on WT coefficient maxima.

articleTitle: A dual-channel millimeter wave radiometer
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The paper describes a dual-channel millimeter wave radiometer system with high resolution, which is used to remotely sense integrated water vapor and integrated liquid water in the troposphere. A new structure that is similar to noise-adding radiometer and periodic calibration technology is adopted in this system. The radiometer system is positioned on a table, which can scan between 0/spl deg//spl sim/360/spl deg/ in azimuth and 0/spl deg//spl sim/90/spl deg/ in elevation. Observing results are stored in PC and can be digitally processed to reduce troposphere information. Some practical results are given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: The simulation and analyzing of ferrite grids used in EMC anechoic chamber
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Ferrite grid is generally used in EMC anechoic chamber combined with the urethane pyramids to get good absorbing effect. Grid has superior performance than ferrite tile. This paper gives some key points in the modeling of the grid, including the disposal for dispersive material and boundary condition. Then some simulated results from different aspect are presented to get some guidelines for designing.

articleTitle: Spherical antenna arrays for phase mode processing
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents an improved spherical antenna arrays based on icosahedron for phase mode processing. In this topology, the electrical environment of all elements is almost identical in the case of the excitation of any phase mode. This feature is useful for three-dimensional beam scanning and for minimizing and compensating the effects of mutual coupling. The use of directional elements on this array for wideband applications is discussed

articleTitle: Suppression of narrowband interference in DSSS systems based on MWPT and CWPT
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Two new narrow band interference (NBI) suppression methods based on multi-band wavelet packet transform (MWPT) and complex wavelet packet transform (CWPT) in direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) systems are presented in this paper. With these two techniques, jammed DSSS signal is decomposed separately using MWPT and CWPT in order to separate desirable signal from jamming signal. The DSSS signal is recovered by wavelet reconstruction after the interference signal is filtered out. The results of our simulations show that these two techniques outperform the scheme based on 2-band wavelet packet transform.

articleTitle: Effect of pinout assignment on the crosstalk in ribbon cable
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Ribbon cable, as one kind of transmission lines, is mainly used for the signal transmission in and between electrical equipments of information system. In this paper, the crosstalk in ribbon cable of different pinout assignments is discussed, based on multiconductor transmission line theory. The simulation results give the spectral response and transient response of terminal voltage, which can show the coupling characteristic between the conductors.

articleTitle: A performance improvement of COFDM system with pseudorandom sequence processing technique
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: OFDM based on cyclic prefix (CP) or zero-padding (ZP) is suitable for wireless communications due to its suppression of the multipath fading and resistance to inter-symbol interference (ISI). However, it does not make the simple FFT-based receiver perform well. ISI can be further suppressed by the pseudorandom sequence processing technique which changes the correlation properties of the IFFT matrix [P. D. Papadimitriou et al. (2004)]. This paper analyses this technique theoretically and applies to CP-OFDM, ZP-OFDM, ZP-OFDM-OLA and ZP-OFDM-FAST. Simulation results verify the large gains in the coded performance of the modified methods using this technique, compared to the conventional methods.

articleTitle: Broadband CPW-fed folded-slot log-periodic antenna
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: By combing with the log-periodic and the linear-taper techniques, a broadband CPW-fed folded-slot antenna of 4-elements is presented. The design procedure of this broadband antenna having impedance bandwidth (VSWR < 2) up to 62.7% (4.56 - 8.73 GHz) is described, which offers a new means to enhance the impedance bandwidth of folded-slot antenna. The study on the key parameters and the simulated radiation patterns are also shown.

articleTitle: A contention resolution scheme by using fiber delay lines for optical burst switching
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, we employ fiber delay line (FDL) as optical buffers to reduce the burst-loss probability. We studied an analytical model using a single forward FDL buffering for contention resolution, then built a new model for OBS architecture using both a forward FDL and a feedback FDL. Based on the two models, we designed algorithm for each models, and simulated them with C++ programming language.

articleTitle: An improved transmit antenna selection criterion for V-BLAST system
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Based on sub-optimal sorting and QR decomposition, we propose a transmit antenna selection criterion that is applicable for V-BLAST systems with ordered successive interference cancellation detection. Unlike most of the existing works, this criterion takes into account the impacts of ordering and cancellation. Simulations show that the proposed strategy achieves near-optimal outage capacity and outperforms several existing schemes in performance with reasonable complexity.

articleTitle: Speckle filtering of polarimetric SAR image and the enhancement for classification
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, a new approach to speckle filtering of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data is presented. We define a parameter space consisting of two orthogonal subspaces - the signal subspace and the noise subspace. Then, the full polarimetric information from the signal subspace is obtained after speckle filtering. Moreover, edges of different kinds of targets are preserved. Using polarimetric SAR data, the effectiveness of the proposed method is not only validate by the standard-deviation-to mean ratio, but also by target classification.

articleTitle: Study of the characteristics of radio wave propagation under irregular buildings
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Ray tracing is a widely used technique to predict propagation effects in mobile and personal communication environments: outdoor macrocells, street microcells, and indoor picocells. Ray tracing is used to identify all possible ray paths between a transmitter and a receiver in multipath channels. In the paper we describe a 3-D ray tracing algorithm. We use the UCFDTD model to simulate radio wave propagation of irregular buildings. Then we plot the path gain at 900 MHz calculated using the MWFDTD model along the vertical and horizontal route, respectively. For comparison, in the same figures we also plot the path gain calculated using the urban canyon model

articleTitle: Efficient interference based RRM for speech service in FuTURE TDD system
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: As B3G, system is expected to provide high data rate and high spectrum efficiency with low transmission power, the generalized distributed antenna array is a very promising technique, besides OFDM and MIMO. However, to mitigate the cochannel interference and decrease frequency reuse factor, efficient radio resource management is necessary. In this paper, efficient radio resource management algorithms based on interference are proposed for real time speech in FuTURE TDD system in uplink. Compared to the other subcarrier allocation algorithm such as sequential allocation and 2-D intention subcarrier allocation, the algorithms proposed can improve the system capacity to more than double and the spectrum efficiency of 8 kbps speech service is improved to be about 1.3 Mbps/MHz/cell.

articleTitle: Iterative chase-2 algorithm using threshold for block turbo codes decoding design
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, we introduce an approach to get better performance of block turbo codes (BTCs). We use threshold to limit the search for the maximum-likelihood codeword. Consequently, by using chase-2 algorithm, Euclidean distance will be calculated from smaller group of candidate codeword, and we can calculate reliability and extrinsic information easier and faster. So a faster iterative decoding process is achieved to take these extra threshold calculations into chase-2 algorithm for BTCs. We evaluate the performance of this decoding process on additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel. And decoding complexity reduces a lot over the standard iterative decoding methods. We also add this idea into the hardware design of BTCs decoder. It also shows good reduction for number of operations.

articleTitle: Network signaling compression for bit loading
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Link adaptation technology has been introduced in new generation transmission systems such as 3-G or 4-G optimizing both their throughput and their power consumption. The adaptation of radio configuration requires information about the radio link quality. The information most be exchanged between the access point and the mobile terminal, leading to an associated dealing load, whose amount may decrease the system transmission efficiency. A mechanism for reducing the amount of dealing information has to be designed for increasing the overall system capacity (more users, more available bandwidth). This paper addresses multi-carrier systems whose link adaptation is called out by means of bit load tag algorithms. However, the associated signaling load increases quickly with the number of sub-curriers, modulation schemes and users. These bit-loading vectors are considered a-priori known at the receiver, and almost no literature concerning transmission of such information is available. In realistic transmission systems, correlation exists in time due to Doppler effect, and in frequency due to multi-path delay spread. We intend to exploit this two fold redundancy to decrease the signaling information load related to the power vector data for bit loading. A compression system for both bit allocation and power allocation of the bit loading is proposed. The performance of such compression system is then evaluated.

articleTitle: High loss multilayer films for control of electro-magnetic interference
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A nanostructure multilayer film, composed of magnetic alloy CoFeZrNd layer and nonmagnetic insulator SiO/sub 2/ layer, was adopted as the composite structure material. The CoFeZrNd/SiO/sub 2/ multilayer films were synthesized by magnetron sputtering. Microstructures, electromagnetic parameters and microwave characteristics were all measured and analysed. Results show that these magnetic nanostructure multilayer films can be used in control of EMI in circuits and systems.

articleTitle: Distinguishing concrete-way from grassplot with MMW band
publicationTitle: 2005 IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The engineering design of a millimeter-wave (MMW) active/passive (A/P) combinative detector have previously been presented in Z. L.
